issues.summary: The complete staged RO map does not transition from init_game to in_game through the standard SC2 API CreateGame/JoinGame path.
issues.impact: Native commander, faction, unit ownership, map alliance, and AI ally behavior cannot be accepted.
issues.nextAction: Run the bounded runtime-bootstrap diagnosis in next-stage-plan.md. Require strict response status checks and a known-good map comparison before changing RO map or AI logic.

issues.summary: Twenty-four RO maps still contain dynamically resolved owners or alliance expressions that the safe adapter cannot authorize statically.
issues.impact: The adapter may expose fewer runtime targets than the mission creates, but it will not infer allies or enemies from unresolved values.
issues.nextAction: Capture native owner/alliance state for representative maps after RO reaches in_game; do not widen the contract before that evidence exists.

issues.summary: The current RO-specific API probe is permissive when JoinGame returns no nested error but the top-level status remains launched.
issues.impact: A permissive probe can produce a zero-unit report without failing at the exact state transition boundary.
issues.nextAction: Use the strict RealSmoke/RealProfile response-status pattern in the next runtime harness; do not promote the existing probe's exit code to a runtime pass.
